# Mediportal

> > Mediportal is a healthcare technology platform offering EMR software, medical data interoperability solutions, and enterprise health IT tools designed to streamline clinical workflows and enable seamless data exchange across healthcare systems.

Mediportal provides comprehensive healthcare IT solutions including the M-Power EMR platform, M-Power MIE (Medical Information Exchange) for interoperability, and enterprise ecosystem products. The platform emphasizes HIPAA compliance, telemedicine capabilities, and bi-directional data exchange to address healthcare data silos and support value-based care models.

## Key Topics

- M-Power EMR
- M-Power MIE
- Healthcare Interoperability
- FHIR/HL7 Integration
- SyncAI Engine
- Data Exchange
- Electronic Medical Records (EMR)
- HIPAA Compliance
- Telemedicine
- Patient Portal
- Clinical Workflows
- Value-Based Care
- Healthcare Data Integration
- Enterprise Solutions
- Care Coordination

## Core Platform Products

- [Electronic Medical Records - Mediportal](https://www.mediportal.com/platform/electronic-medical-records): M-Power EMR platform with HIPAA compliance and telemedicine capabilities
- [Interoperability - Mediportal](https://www.mediportal.com/platform/interoperability): Medical Information Exchange platform with FHIR/HL7 integration and SyncAI Engine
- [Enterprise - Mediportal](https://www.mediportal.com/platform/enterprise): Enterprise M-Power platform with HIPAA compliance and mobile customization
